svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="roles-and-access" name="Who can do what"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="Who can do what" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="admin" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Admin
every page and setting" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="280" x="20" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="demo" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Demo (read-only)
sees what an admin sees" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="280" x="20" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="author" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Author
own posts, comments, profile, API keys" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="280" x="20" y="260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reader" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Reader
public site and comments only" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="280" x="20" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="read" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Open pages, filter,
search, preview" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="400" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="write" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Save, publish, delete,
send, sync, run AI" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="400" y="250" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gate" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Who is
writing?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="130" x="670" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ok" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Allowed
(role check)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="170" x="880" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="deny" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Refused: read-only notice
(nothing stored, nothing sent)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="230" x="880" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="admin" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="read" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="demo" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="read" value="views"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="demo" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="write" value="changes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="author" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="write" value="own posts"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="write" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="gate" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="gate" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="ok" value="admin / author"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="gate" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="deny" value="demo"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
